inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation 'share-based compensation, gross' RMB247.5m (0780.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:12214); no net-share-settlement tax line disclosed, so the combined figure equals the gross expense
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1721, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10. Statements and all flows are RMB (CNY); the HKEX quote is HKD. No dual listing exists for a parity check (Tongcheng has no US ADR); direction verified against the FY2025 final dividend, declared HKD0.25/share and booked at RMB507.5m for 2,340m shares (implied 1.153 at the March-2026 declaration rate, consistent with CNY->HKD above 1). Note that refresh_price.py moves the price but never this rate.
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,354.31m issued shares at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, directors' interests note) plus 15.7m dilutive RSU and share-option adjustments from the H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS note (11.2m + 4.6m) = 2,370m fully diluted; held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). No buybacks in any year on record; the flat count is a modelling convention the company funds through SBC expensing, not through repurchases.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' own currency (CNY): China 10-year CGB ~1.8% risk-free, 7.0% equity risk premium for HK-listed Chinese equities (mature-market ERP plus a China country premium), equity beta ~1.15 for a consumer-discretionary online travel platform -> cost of equity ~9.9%; borrowings RMB4.2bn at ~3% pre-tax against an RMB20bn market cap pull the blend to ~9.5%. Same 9.5% in all three scenarios: regulatory, competitive and demand risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked again in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (principal plus interest, 'Payment on lease liabilities' RMB401.7m FY2025 = 2.07% of revenue; RMB174.2m H1 FY2026 = 1.74%) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path at 1.9%, and lease liabilities (RMB1,208m at 30 June 2026: 913.3 non-current + 294.9 current) are EXCLUDED from total_debt. D&A for the cash-tax line is ex right-of-use depreciation: FY2025 total D&A RMB1,299m = PPE depreciation 289 + ROU depreciation 211 + intangibles amortisation 799 (almost all acquisition-related and not a cash or tax-deductible cost at group level), so da_pct is set at 3.0% (PPE depreciation 1.5% plus the deductible part of amortisation) converging to the 2.8% capex rate.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (adjusted EBITDA is group-level), so the NCI is charged once in the bridge: non-controlling interests of RMB1,019.5m at 30 June 2026 deducted. NCI profit share was only RMB37.9m in FY2025 (1.6% of net profit), so the book deduction is the more conservative of the two treatments. FY0 tie: adjusted EBIT 5,138 - 248 SBC - 1,299 D&A = 3,591 x (1 - 20%) = 2,873, against reported attributable net income 2,371 + 453 goodwill impairment + 38 NCI = 2,862.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: operating company, consumer internet marketplace; non-US adaptations applied for currency, leases, NCI and non-operating assets). Tongcheng is an asset-light online travel agency (commission/service-fee revenue) with a hotel-management arm (Elong, Wanda Hotels acquired Oct 2025) - its value is a stream of free cash flow, so no other route applies. OWNER FCF: last_fcf = reported FCF 3,746.7 - SBC 247.5 - finance income 171.7 = 3,327.5 (RMB m, FY2025). Interest income is stripped because net cash (RMB10.1bn incl. short-term investments) is ~3x the FCF base; on the lease-adjusted (treatment B) basis FY2025 owner FCF was 2,925.8 (15.1% of revenue) after the RMB401.7m lease cash. EBITDA BASIS: the ebitda_margin_path is the company's adjusted-EBITDA margin (FY2025 26.5%, H1 FY2026 26.6%), which adds back SBC (charged separately via sbc_pct_path) and the one-off RMB453.4m tourism goodwill impairment; the Metrics.csv 'ebitda' (reported operating profit + D&A, 22.9%) is after both. CASH: cash 14,262.2 = cash and equivalents 6,782.3 + short-term investments 7,479.9 (term deposits at amortised cost and wealth-management products, 30 June 2026); restricted cash 446.0 excluded. Net cash is pre two post-balance-sheet outflows: the FY2025 final dividend (RMB507.5m paid 15 July 2026, deducted in equity_bridge because the 9 Oct price is ex that payment) and the Dida Inc. general offer (HKD1.3875 x 910.8m accepted shares ~= HKD1,264m ~= RMB1,078m paid Aug 2026 for 88.7% of a cash-rich ride-sharing platform), treated as a value-neutral asset swap and not adjusted. The Wanda Hotels acquisition (RMB2.5bn, completed Oct 2025) is already in the 30 June 2026 balance sheet and in H1 FY2026 revenue. GUIDANCE: management guided core-OTA mid-teens growth for FY2026 after FY2025 results; H1 FY2026 delivered +10.5% total revenue (Q2 +6.8%, average MPUs -5.8% YoY) with management flagging subdued summer demand on fuel surcharges and extreme weather, so the FY2026 driver sits at 8.5%, below guidance. SHARE COUNT: flat at 2,370m fully diluted. WORKING CAPITAL: wc_capture 0 - cash generated from operations ran below adjusted EBITDA in FY2024 and FY2025 and above it in FY2023, so no structural growth tailwind is credited. HORIZON: 10 years, because margins and the cash tax rate are still ramping at year 5. TERMINAL CAP: 12x owner FCF in the base case (roughly 7x EV/adjusted EBITDA) rather than the 20x house default - China consumer internet, discretionary travel cyclicality and the regulatory discount all argue for a lower exit multiple; 15x bull, 10x bear. NO-RE-RATE MEMO: at the 9 Oct price the stock trades at ~2x EV/adjusted EBITDA and ~3x EV/owner FCF; the gap between the house value and the price is almost entirely the price of the market's regulatory/China discount, not of any growth assumption.
inputs.data_vintage: Price 2026-10-09 close; balance sheet, share count, lease and NCI figures from the H1 FY2026 interim report (30 June 2026); FY0 flows, SBC, interest income and D&A split from the FY2025 annual report (31 December 2025).

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet; flows are consolidated so the NCI is deducted once here (see nci_treatment)

Equity-method associates, FVTPL stakes in private companies and an investment fund (H1 FY2026 interim, RMB2,918.4m at 30 June 2026). Their income (share of associates, dividends received RMB8.8m) is below operating profit and therefore outside the EBITDA-based flows, so the matching asset belongs in the bridge; haircut 50% for illiquidity and the private-company marks.
HKD0.25/share, RMB507.5m per the H1 FY2026 interim; paid after the 30 June balance sheet date and before the 9 Oct 2026 price, so the net cash is reduced by it

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (10.0%) as the structural anchor, tempered to 8.5% for FY2026 by the H1 FY2026 run-rate (+10.5%) and the Q2 slowdown (+6.8%)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Revenue (26.7%) and EPS (46.4%) 5-year CAGRs are measured from the FY2020 COVID trough and overstate structural growth by a wide margin; the 3-year revenue CAGR (43.3%) starts from the FY2022 lockdown year and is meaningless. Equity CAGR (10.0%/12.8%) is the only series with a clean base and is the one used.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are not computable: owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - interest income) was negative in FY2020 (-450) and FY2022 (-730), the two lockdown years. From FY2023 (owner FCF 2,686.8) to FY2025 (3,327.5) the 2-year CAGR is 11.3%, against reported-FCF growth of 8.0% over the same span: SBC fell from 348 to 248 while finance income stayed ~170, so owner FCF has grown FASTER than reported FCF - the opposite of the usual SBC-drag pattern. Pre-COVID (FY2018 -> FY2019) revenue grew 40.7% off the Tongcheng/Elong merger; FY2019 -> FY2025 revenue CAGR is 17.4% and adjusted net profit CAGR 14.1%.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 8.5%: H1 +10.5% but Q2 +6.8% with MPUs down and management flagging a soft summer; Wanda consolidation supports H2. FY2027 holds 8.5% as Dida (88.7% acquired Aug 2026) consolidates and hotel management compounds. Then a glide to 2.5% as lower-tier-city penetration matures.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted-EBITDA margin from 26.5% (FY2025; H1 FY2026 26.6%) to 28% by year 7 on operating leverage and asset-light hotel-management mix; stops well short of Trip.com's ~30%+ because of the structural gross-margin gap (66% vs ~81%).
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax 17.5% of adjusted EBIT in FY2025 (RMB629m paid), GAAP ETR 20%; ramps to 22% as HNTE preferential rates roll off and Pillar Two's 15% floor bites on the offshore entities.

scenario_narratives.base: Tongcheng stays China's mass-market, lower-tier-city OTA inside the Weixin ecosystem, with the Tencent and Trip.com relationships intact but no longer a source of advantage. Core OTA grows high-single-digit (accommodation and 'others' double-digit, transportation mid-single-digit, tourism flat to down) and the hotel-management arm (Elong + Wanda, 3,500 hotels open and 2,000 in pipeline) plus Dida add inorganic revenue in FY2026-27. Adjusted-EBITDA margin drifts from 26.5% to 28% on operating leverage; the structural 66%-vs-81% gross-margin gap to Trip.com means it never closes fully. The Trip.com antitrust settlement (RMB5.3bn, July 2026) does not spill over into a Tongcheng penalty, and shared hotel supply continues on commercial terms. Cash tax normalises from 17.5% to 22%. The terminal multiple is capped at 12x owner FCF (~7x EV/EBITDA) - a China consumer-internet exit, not a US one.
scenario_narratives.bull: Lower-tier-city penetration and experiential-travel demand keep core OTA at the guided mid-teens through FY2027, outbound/international recovers on visa-free expansion and restored flight capacity, and the Wanda/Elong hotel-management pipeline converts into a high-margin third leg. SAMR's remedies against Trip.com loosen its grip on shared hotel supply, letting Tongcheng, Meituan and Fliggy take share and lift take-rates, so adjusted-EBITDA margin reaches 30%. SBC keeps falling toward 0.7% of revenue, tax settles at 21%, and a buyer pays 15x terminal owner FCF. The bull case requires three independent things to land - Wanda integration, outbound recovery and a favourable antitrust read-through - which is why it carries a 20% weight rather than the 35% default.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2026 demand soft patch (fuel surcharges, extreme weather, Q2 MPUs -5.8%) persists, and the antitrust episode turns against Tongcheng: either a direct SAMR finding on its own hotel-pricing practices or remedies that force Trip.com to withdraw or reprice shared supply, stripping inventory from the accommodation segment. Meituan and Fliggy press into lower-tier cities with local-services traffic while Weixin placement economics worsen, so growth falls to 2-3% and adjusted-EBITDA margin erodes to 22.5% as marketing spend rises to defend the user base. Tourism keeps shrinking after the FY2025 RMB453m goodwill impairment, Wanda integration costs run ahead of fees, HNTE preferences lapse (tax 24%), and the terminal multiple is 10x. The bear still generates positive cash - the balance sheet (RMB10bn net cash) carries no solvency risk - so this is a growth-and-margin bear, not a going-concern one.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: a single-regulator overhang (SAMR's OTA antitrust action, with Tongcheng's own practices reportedly under scrutiny), a single-channel traffic dependency (Weixin) and a single-supplier dependency (Trip.com, also a 21-24% shareholder) are three concentration risks the method says warrant a heavier bear, and the 2026 run-rate (Q2 +6.8%, MPUs down) is already drifting toward it; the -60% share-price move over the past year says the market is weighting it heavily too. Bull cut to 20% because it needs Wanda integration, outbound recovery and a favourable antitrust read-through to land together. Base holds 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Tongcheng on fully SBC-expensed owner free cash flow in RMB, discounted at a CNY-built 9.5% WACC, with lease cash charged as an operating cost, the NCI deducted once at book, interest income stripped and the RMB14.3bn cash-plus-deposits pile added back net of RMB4.2bn borrowings and the July 2026 dividend. Scenarios carry the regulatory, competitive and demand risk; the discount rate does not carry it twice. The terminal value is capped at a China-appropriate 10-15x owner FCF rather than the 20x house default. Per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD at 1.1721 so they are comparable to the HKEX quote.
key_risks_to_valuation: SAMR antitrust spillover from Trip.com onto Tongcheng itself (a fine, or remedies that remove or reprice Trip.com-sourced hotel supply) - the bear axis the 30% weight is for
Weixin ecosystem distribution terms: ~87% of users are in lower-tier cities reached through Tencent's Mini Program; a change in placement or traffic economics hits user acquisition cost directly
Meituan and Fliggy pushing into lower-tier-city travel with local-services traffic, compressing take-rates and lifting marketing spend
Chinese consumer discretionary demand and airfare pass-through: FY2026 transportation ticketing and outbound tourism have already softened on fuel surcharges
Integration of Wanda Hotels (RMB2.5bn, Oct 2025) and Dida Inc. (RMB~1.1bn, Aug 2026): both were cash-funded acquisitions whose returns are not yet visible in the flows
Long-term investments (RMB2.9bn of private stakes, taken at 50% of book) and short-term wealth-management products (RMB7.5bn, taken at face) are less liquid than cash
FX: the CNY->HKD rate used to convert the RMB value into the HKD quote is dated 2026-10-10 and is not refreshed by price-only updates
